description: This file defines the Command class within the AWS SDK for PHP, representing a command object with properties such as name, handler list, authentication schemes, and metrics. It provides methods for accessing and manipulating these properties, including deprecated methods related to authentication schemes.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Represents an AWS command with properties such as name, handler list, auth schemes, and metrics, with methods for managing command parameters and execution details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Command object with name, arguments, handler list, and metrics builder.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Clones the handler list when the command object is cloned.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the command.

methods.name: hasParam
methods.description: Checks if a parameter exists in the command data.

methods.name: getHandlerList
methods.description: Returns the handler list associated with the command.

methods.name: setAuthSchemes
methods.description: Sets authentication schemes for the command (deprecated method).

methods.name: getAuthSchemes
methods.description: Retrieves authentication schemes for the command (deprecated method).

methods.name: get
methods.description: Deprecated method to get a parameter value.

methods.name: getMetricsBuilder
methods.description: Returns the metrics builder associated with the command.
